item.title: BUILD HENDERSONVILLE NEW PARTICIPATORY BUDGET PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF HENDERSONVILLE
item.description: – The City of Hendersonville is making its budget process moreinteractive than ever with the launch of a new participatory budgeting program called BuildHendersonville. The City is setting aside $25,000 for residents to decide how the funds should be used to improve thecommunity. item.title: WEATHER WARN DAYS THE LATEST ON THE NEXT WINTER STORM TAKING AIM AT THE CAROLINAS
item.description: Another winter storm is taking aim at the Carolinas this weekend. Weather Warn Days have been issued by News 13 meteorologists from Friday-Monday for the potential of accumulating snow. There is a 100% chance of more brutal cold this weekend, with highs in the low 20s Saturday, single digit lows early Sunday. item.title: BLUE RIDGE COMMUNITY COLLEGE ALERT
item.description: Blue Ridge Alert: As ice clean up persists across WNC, all Blue Ridge Community College campuses will open at 10 a.m. on Thursday, Jan. 29, 2026. This will allow our facilities teams to continue to salt and clear walkways and roadways in preparation for a safe return. (The College remains closed today, Jan. 28.)
